description: The zstack agent style: the fire router with its playbooks and principles, and figure-it-out for a bespoke playbook.

interface.shortDescription: Rigorous agent workflows routed by fire
interface.longDescription: The zstack agent style, ported from pstack: the fire router matches a task to a playbook (investigation, bug fix, feature, refactoring, perf, forensics, prototype, eval, session pickup, opening a PR), grounds every decision in 24 principles, and delegates to leaf skills across the marketplace; figure-it-out designs a bespoke playbook when none fits.
defaultPrompt: Work in the fire style on this task.
Figure out a rigorous playbook for this migration.
